name: OCD
description: Pattern characterized by repetitive intrusive thoughts or urge loops.
safetyGuidance: This is not a clinical diagnosis. This app does not provide clinical Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) therapy.

solutions.title: Guided Breathing
solutions.purpose: Provide a short calming breathing activity.
instructions: Inhale slowly for 4 seconds.
Hold your breath gently for 4 seconds.
Exhale smoothly for 4 seconds.
Hold empty for 4 seconds before the next breath.

solutions.title: Mindfulness Meditation
solutions.purpose: Help the user observe thoughts without immediately reacting to them.
instructions: Sit comfortably and bring awareness to your breathing.
Notice thoughts as neutral Mental Events passing through awareness.
Resist the urge to analyze, fight, or fix the thoughts right now.
Rest in open awareness until the session ends.

solutions.title: Grounding Exercise
solutions.purpose: Redirect attention toward the present moment.
instructions: Focus physically on your feet pressing into the floor.
Identify 5 distinct shapes or colors around you.
Touch 4 different textures nearby (fabric, wood, metal).
Listen closely for 3 background sounds.

solutions.title: Thought Observation
solutions.purpose: Provide a structured activity for noticing thoughts without requiring the user to act on every thought.
instructions: Acknowledge the current thought without labeling it as good or bad.
Remind yourself: 'Thoughts are mental occurrences, not mandatory actions.'
Observe the rise and gradual fall of mental urgency.
Maintain focus on your anchor (breath or feet) as time elapses.

solutions.title: Relaxation Exercise
solutions.purpose: Provide a short physical/mental relaxation activity.
instructions: Drop your shoulders away from your ears.
Unclench your jaw and let your tongue rest loosely.
Take deep belly breaths, allowing your body to soften.
Remain still and quiet until the timer finishes.
